Subject: Vendor setup question: invoice submission and PO matching

Hi Michael,

Thanks for the fast intro last week. We're kicking off the vendor setup for PaperTrail Logistics and wanted to confirm a couple of operational details so our billing system can be aligned:

- Do you prefer vendors to submit invoices via the Redwood Vendor Portal or is email still supported as a primary intake?
- If portal is preferred, can you share a sample CSV layout (column names and required fields) so we can map our export?
- If email is allowed as a fallback, what is the exact subject and body formatting you need for PO matching? Also any limits on attachments (PDF vs XML) would be helpful.

We have our procurement team ready to fill the onboarding form — we can provide W-9 and bank details once we know the expected method. Hoping to go live with billing by the end of the month.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Billing Operations 
PaperTrail Logistics

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@papertrail.co>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup question: invoice submission and PO matching

Elena — thanks for the note and welcome. Short answers first: we strongly prefer vendors use our Vendor Portal (structured ingest) for production invoices. Email is supported as a temporary fallback but requires a strict subject/body format and has a longer processing SLA.

Mandatory fields (portal / CSV):
- vendor_name (string)
- vendor_tax_id (EIN/SSN equivalent)
- invoice_number (string)
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- invoice_total (decimal, USD)
- currency (3-letter)
- po_number (string) — if missing, invoice will route to exceptions queue
- line_items (semi-colon delimited rows or separate line CSV; see sample below)

Recommended column order (CSV template attached):
vendor_name,vendor_tax_id,invoice_number,invoice_date,invoice_total,currency,po_number,ship_to_code,term_days,account_code,line_item_description,line_item_qty,line_item_unit_price,line_item_tax

Notes on PO matching: we match on the po_number field first; then line-level amounts must sum to invoice_total within $0.50 tolerance. If PO is not present, AP will hold the invoice and you'll see a status of "Requires PO" in the portal.

Email fallback (temporary onboarding only):
- Send to ap-invoices@redwood.com
- Subject must start with: Invoice: <VendorName> | INV:<InvoiceNumber> | PO:<PO# or NONE>
  Example: Invoice: PaperTrail Logistics | INV:PT-2027-091 | PO:PO-12345
- Include a single PDF attachment (scanned or native). We accept one XML in addition to the PDF if you have electronic invoices. Max combined size 10MB.
- Put the invoice total and PO in the body top 3 lines for rapid parsing (we'll include a sample email below).

Onboarding steps (next actions):
1) Please complete the vendor onboarding form here: https://redwood.app/vendor-onboarding/form/PR-2938
2) Upload W-9 and bank details to the secure form.
3) We will provision portal access and send you a test CSV schema (attached: papertrail_vendor_portal_template_v1.csv).
4) Schedule a 30-min test ingestion with AP (cc Vanessa) to validate mapping.

Temporary exceptions: we can enable the email fallback for up to two weeks while you finish integration, but we need your confirmation to turn it on.

Sample email body for fallback:
Invoice total: $12,450.75
PO: PO-12345
Notes: Freight billed to vendor

Thanks — I put Vanessa on cc to coordinate the go-live schedule.

—Michael
Michael Grant
Program Manager, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: papertrail_vendor_portal_template_v1.csv (stub)
